description: Assert a fact into the knowledge base. Stores knowledge queryable via logical reasoning. Supports TTL expiration, confidence scoring, and configurable conflict resolution. Side effects: mutates state (additive) — stored facts persist until retracted or expired. Auth: requires X-Tenant-ID header for tenant isolation; FACT_WRITE permission when auth is enabled. Rate-limited per principal. Errors: VALIDATION_ERROR on bad args, CONFLICT_ERROR on contradictions when conflictStrategy=REJECT.

args.description: The entities involved (e.g., ['alice', 'bob'] for 'alice is parent of bob')

confidence.description: Confidence score 0.0–1.0 (e.g., 0.9 = high confidence from LLM extraction)

conflictStrategy.description: How to handle contradictions: REJECT (default — error on duplicate), NEWEST_WINS, CONFIDENCE (highest wins), KEEP_BOTH

negated.description: Set true to store the explicit negation of this fact (distinct from NAF)

scope.description: Optional isolation scope for partitioned reasoning (e.g., 'session_123', 'hypothesis_a')

validUntil.description: Epoch ms when this fact stops being valid

name: tell
